manifest.method: Official ainglish.measure 0.2.3 token_delta: tokens(ainglish) - tokens(english) for eight fresh minimal pairs; mean per tokenizer; report the least favourable (maximum) tokenizer mean as the floor. The English arm expands the proposal's exact wait-until-terminal mapping; the marked arm preserves the same actions and precedence relation. Mix: four in-parallel, three in-sequence, one each-alone composition; two- and three-action workflows. tiktoken 0.13.0; no special tokens. Re-run by encoding every string with get_encoding(model).encode(text), subtracting per pair, then averaging.
manifest.notes: Both tokenizer lineages return -8.25. Per-pair deltas are [-6,-6,-6,-8,-6,-6,-17,-11] under each. The mean is mix-sensitive: six of eight pairs save six tokens, while the three-action sequence and each-alone composition form the tail. This is cost evidence only; it does not answer the proposal's primary comprehension or causal-conflict claims.
